rationale: Recurring MoF public-notice board surfacing non-ESJN calls with financial-services buying intent; failed URL is a soft signal only.
Legacy MoF archive valuable for multi-year vendor/price history but static and unverified; re-check liveness before monitoring.
Verified tax-authority site buying payment/collection, card and IT services; durable contracting-authority source.
Single internal procedure PDF — useful evidence on UJP buying workflow and FOI targets, not a recurring feed.
Customs procurement section publishes plans, notices, contracts and full dossiers on its own domain; high-value payments-channel buyer.
Legacy Customs mirror adds historical depth only; verify it still resolves before monitoring.
Major extra-budgetary buyer of banking/payment-processing services with its own procurement PDF repository.
Pension fund disburses ~600k payments via banks and publishes procurement decisions; core demand-side actor.
Treasury section of finance.gov.mk gives institutional payments context but is a sub-page of the MoF site already covered.
CFCD runs IPA/EU-funded tenders including financial-sector and IT modernisation, published outside ESJN in MK and EN.
General Secretariat procurement plan page; small but recurring, and a pointer to government-level authorisations.
FOI holders register with officer contacts — mine once to build the FOI routing table for unpublished procurement documents.
FZO information-inventory sub-page under a site already monitored; useful only to frame FOI requests.
Verified canonical institution directory — mine once to build the contracting-authority actor map, then refresh periodically.
Banking association member list is the canonical MK bank/KIBS/credit-bureau actor roster; mine once and re-check on membership change.
SKIBOR panel list is a small sub-page of mba.mk already covered by the members page.
MASIT member directory enumerates the local ICT vendor/integrator tail that bids on bank and public payments tenders.
Chamber registry useful once to enumerate other sectoral chambers; low standalone signal value.
Chamber's financial-organisations association gives a cross-check member list of finance-sector actors.
National business registry — authoritative entity resolution for every bank, PSP and supplier in tender data.
Licensed bulk-data channel from the registry requires an account; a human must clear registration and terms first.
Registry open-data/publications feed gives early signal on supplier viability and new PSP/fintech incorporations.
ESJN concluded-contracts register by institution turns award data into a supplier map; verified and legally clear.
